title: Mixed A1
prompt:
**Bài toán.** Given n integers, count pairs (i, j) with i < j and
a[i] > 2·a[j].

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n ≤ 200000; 0 ≤ a[i] < 100000.

**Input:** line 1: n; line 2: n values.
**Output:** one integer — the count (fits in 64 bits).

tests.name: sample
sorted asc
tests.hint: a[i] stands before a[j] but is smaller — never wins → 0.

tests.name: descending
equality edge
tests.hint: 6 > 2·3 is 6 > 6 — false. Strict comparison; the wrong ≥-counter reports 1 here.

tests.name: full scale
tests.hint: Requires an O(n log n) merge-style count; O(n²) is 2·10^10 pair checks.
